blocks.value: **The UML class diagram describes the structure of a class by displaying the class name (first row), variables (second row), and methods (third row).**

┌─────────────────────────────────┐
│ BankAccount                     │   ← class name
├─────────────────────────────────┤
│ - accountNumber : String        │   ← variables
│ - owner : String                │
│ - balance : double              │
├─────────────────────────────────┤
│ + getBalance() : double         │   ← methods
│ + deposit(amount : double)      │
│ + withdraw(amount : double)     │
│ - logTransaction(...)           │
└─────────────────────────────────┘
`-` marks private, `+` marks public. A well-encapsulated class shows mostly `-` in the middle row and mostly `+` in the bottom one.
